scope.summary: Both changes add a nesting limit check to printing. The harness parses input before printing, and the supplied array and object parsers use the same limit. The missing parse dispatch and OSS-Fuzz build script prevent an affirmative sufficiency assessment.

assessments.reason: The harness can print parsed arrays through each print API, but the omitted parse_value body prevents confirming that every array it supplies respects the printer's new depth check.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The array parser applies the corresponding input depth check.
Printing dispatches array values to print_array.

assessments.reason: The harness can print parsed objects through each print API, but the omitted parse_value body prevents confirming that every object it supplies respects the printer's new depth check.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The object parser applies the corresponding input depth check.
Printing dispatches object values to print_object.

build.reason: The supplied build script delegates to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, which is not supplied. The CMake files do not establish how that script builds this target.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the supplied CMake target involving the fuzzer, but the delegated script's use of it is unknown.

input.reason: The entry requires a trailing NUL, passes the bytes after its four control bytes to the string parser, and uses the parser's NULL result to reject inputs it cannot parse.

evidence.dependency_reason: The called parser measures the NUL-terminated string and delegates to the length-aware parser.
The delegated parser returns an item only after parsing and any requested termination check.

lifecycle.reason: The entry frees print output and deletes the parsed tree, and library failure paths clean up. The supplied source does not show the default allocation hooks needed to confirm that free matches the print allocator.

evidence.dependency_reason: Unbuffered printing uses hooks for output allocation and failure cleanup.
Buffered printing uses global hooks for allocation and failure cleanup.
The final harness call recursively releases the parsed tree.

control_flow.reason: Printing dispatch and cleanup are supplied, but parse_value is omitted. Its dispatch and depth handling are decisive for relating reachable parsed nesting to both new print checks.

evidence.dependency_reason: Print dispatch reaches the changed array and object functions.
The parser invokes the omitted parse_value body and deletes an item on failure.

missing_information: Complete body of parse_value in cJSON.c, including its array and object dispatch.
Definition of CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT in cJSON.h or cJSON.c.
Definition and initialization of global_hooks in cJSON.c, including any cJSON_InitHooks behavior relevant to this build.
